title: Sensibo AC Runtime Exceeds Weather Need
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensibo:climate
join outdoor_temp [search index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs]
where runtime_min>120 AND outdoor_temp_c<22
description: Compares Sensibo AC runtime against mild outdoor temperatures.
value: Surfacing sensibo ac runtime exceeds weather need helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant smart home devices & sensors export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back when sensibo ac runtime exceeds weather need matters for your routine.
